name: catsmoke
description: cat(1) end-to-end over the dead-stripped libc (libc-breakup task 4). cat is the anchor tool for the libc archive conversion -- it selects 7 of the archive's 42 members -- and nothing else in the corpus reads a file through it. Asserts the CONTENT of /etc/hosts reaches the screen, so a mis-selected stdio/string member shows up as wrong or missing output rather than as a silent exit 0.
